challenges.name: section-with-waitlist
challenges.title: Write a Section class that never overfills
challenges.description: The ported enrolment tool lets any code path change a section's numbers, and CS101-02 ended up with 47 students in a 40-seat lab. Write a Section class whose private data can only change through its member functions: the constructor rejects a capacity that is not positive with std::invalid_argument("capacity must be > 0"); enroll(id) returns "enrolled" while there is a free seat, "waitlisted" when the section is full, and "duplicate" if the student is already enrolled or already waiting; drop(id) frees the seat and moves the first waitlisted student into it ("dropped, promoted <id>"), or returns "dropped", "left waitlist" or "not found". The test runner reads the section and a list of commands from stdin, prints the result of each command and then the final summary() through a const reference.
